newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE says February futures trade volume up 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: WCE says February futures trade volume up 26 pct.

text.p: Volume of trade in Winnipeg Commodity Exchange futures contracts rose 26.1 percent in February compared to the same month last year, the WCE said.
A total of 187,474 futures contracts were exchanged in February and the cumulative total for the 1996/97 crop year (Aug/July) reached 1,239,616 contracts, or 23.9 percent above last year.
Canola futures trade rose 33.8 percent in February 1997 from February 1996, with a total of 133,056 contracts changing hands, the WCE said in a statement.
Trade was 19.9 percent higher in the year to date compared with the same period last year at 813,327 contracts.
Open interest in canola at the end of February was 43,183 contracts outstanding.
Feed wheat futures trade was 38.1 percent higher than in February 1996 in the past month on a volume of 16,744 contracts.
Feed wheat trade was 27 percent higher in the year to date at 141,728 contracts exchanged. Open interest on February 28 at 15,345 contracts was almost double compared with the same time last year.
Barley futures trade rose 22.2 percent in February 1997 versus the same month a year ago with a total of 30,298 contracts traded.

Barley trade at 221,811 contracts was 81.6 percent higher to date in the crop year compared to the same period last year. Open interest on February 28 was up 25.6 percent from last year with 17,578 contracts outstanding.
